visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and glasses wearing a black button-down shirt stands centrally in front of a clean, bright white studio background. He uses active hand gestures, raising his right hand to emphasize his opening points. (2) A rectangular inset image appears on the left side of the frame, displaying a cluster of small, brownish, rounded objects found on the Mars surface. (3) The inset image switches to a full-screen view of the 'Mars eggs,' showing granular textures and small surface holes in high detail. (4) The scene returns to the man speaking directly to the camera; he uses expressive hand movements, including a finger-pinch gesture, while a lavalier microphone is visible on his shirt. (5) A new inset appears showing a different perspective of the Mars surface, featuring a large, porous rock formation amidst a field of flatter, lighter-colored rocks. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 火星出現神祕卵狀物 科學家陷沉思. [Subtitle]: 來看科學家在火星上發現的. (2) [Subtitle]: 這個有趣的小東西. (3) [Subtitle]: 欸難道火星上有生物存在嗎. (4) [Subtitle]: 這一顆一顆的超像生物的卵欸. (5) [Subtitle]: 上面還有小小的孔洞. (6) [Subtitle]: 會是它們孵化的痕跡嗎. (7) [Subtitle]: 好啦好啦 其實像這樣的球粒狀礦物. (8) [Subtitle]: 在地球上稱為葡萄狀結核. (9) [Subtitle]: 不過它通常跟特定的水文或火山作用有關. (10) [Subtitle]: 而這塊在火星上發現. (11) [Subtitle]: 被科學家叫做「聖保羅灣」的石頭. (12) [Subtitle]: 來源非常可疑. (13) [Subtitle]: 科學家推測 它可能經歷過隕石衝擊熔融. (14) [Subtitle]: 或遠古火山噴發的瞬間冷卻. (15) [Subtitle]: 也可能和水有關. (16) [Subtitle]: 但非常非常奇怪的是. (17) [Subtitle]: 周圍竟然找不到任何類似的岩石. (18) [Subtitle]: 科學家只能推測 它可能是一塊來自他處的漂浮岩. (19) [Subtitle]: 少了原環境的線索 要判斷成因變得更困難了. (20) [Subtitle]: 而且它為什麼能夠出現在那裡呢. (21) [Subtitle]: 這顆聖保羅灣到底由什麼組成 如何形成. (22) [Subtitle]: 為何會出現在那裡. (23) [Subtitle]: 目前科研團隊只能靠火星探測器毅力號. (24) [Subtitle]: 再靠近一探究竟. (25) [Subtitle]: 希望找出岩石的出生地層. (26) [Subtitle]: 只能說火星真的不斷給我們驚喜. (27) [Subtitle]: 每當我們以為摸清它的脾氣. (28) [Subtitle]: 它就丟出一顆怪石頭來考驗我們.
